correctness.rationale: The exact normalized weights and unbiased factor D yield explicit positive-denominator covariance formulas. Substituting produces a convex relaxation of the tanh map on the invariant open interval; strict concavity gives exactly all fixed points and monotone attraction basins. At criticality the cubic Taylor coefficient yields the exact inverse-square telescope and asymptotic constant. The branch asymptotics follow by the artanh identity. Independent algebraic symbolic factorization and 2095 supplementary stand-alone numerical checks corroborate, but do not substitute for, these proofs.
